title: 'Not very Puro San Antonio': Spurs flag stolen from Riverwalk Alamo Biscuit Co.

A local business is asking the community for help after their Spurs flag was stolen last week. Alamo Biscuit Company along the Riverwalk had the flag hanging outside before game 2 of the Western Conference Finals.
General manager Matthew Quintanilla says the restaurant had planned to celebrate a second Spurs win upstairs, but the team lost to OKC. When employees returned the next day, the 6 by 10 flag was gone.
"We got it to celebrate the community," Quintanilla said. "We wanted to get with the community, show a little celebration- but unfortunately, it did get stolen that night. " We're told the company spent hundreds of dollars installing the flag but they say it's not about the money- they just want it returned. "It's just sad to see that somebody will take something from somebody else and from a local business on the Riverwalk," Quintanilla said.
Anyone with information about the stolen flag is asked to call the restaurant or send them a message on social media. SAN ANTONIO - A deadly accident has shut down a portion of a North Side highway early Tuesday morning.
